push.title: L 1-3 vs man united2112 | You: 7.7 (12th worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.7. Don't let it rent space in your head. Charge it a fee and move on.

THE GOOD
+ 32 passes (up from your usual 17). Everybody wanted the ball at your feet, and for good reason.
+ A goal against man united2112, your first since Oct 1. That's what the ball's for, and you knew it.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Here's what helps: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). Simple fix: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- No key passes from 32 passes. Simple as pie: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side. That's a coach's honest word.
- Shot accuracy 67%, down from your usual 93%. Key note: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That's the scoreboard being honest with us.

Rep it: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

Rome wasn't built in a day, but they were laying bricks every hour. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-3 vs man united2112 | You: 7.2 (7th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.2, PhogsToffees. It's okay to be frustrated. It's not okay to stay frustrated.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ Completed passes 32, up from your usual 15. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.
+ Every time you found BellyTb1, something good happened.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 3 goals conceded pushed +0.1. Underrated work.

THE BAD
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. That's on all of us, not just you, and all of us fix it.
- 0.7 below your usual rating. One match doesn't define you. We go again.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 2. Fix it like this: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. My two cents: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Their humans averaged 8.9 to our 7.6; we were second best man for man. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.

Backyard drill: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: Kindness costs nothing and wins locker rooms.

Mistakes are just lessons in disguise. - Coach Lasso
